format: counting song (1 to 10) with a repeating chorus
title_hi: चिंटू और मिठू के गिनती वाले खिलौने
title_en: Chintu and Mithu's Toy Counting Song
description: Chintu the elephant and Mithu the parrot count their favorite toys together. A fun and rhythmic way for toddlers to learn numbers 1 to 10 in Hindi and English.
learning: Counting numbers 1-10 in both Hindi and English.
